name: DaVinci Edit Page In Out Story Assembly
use_when: The editor needs a clean first assembly in Resolve's Edit page.
Only part of a source clip belongs in the story.
The timeline needs insert, overwrite, replace, place-on-top, or append decisions.
avoid_when: The sequence is a fast rough selects string where Cut page Source Tape is better.
The media has not been organized enough to choose useful source clips.
The edit needs a complex Fusion effect before the basic story can be assembled.

timeline_pattern.pattern: media_pool -> source_viewer -> mark_in_out -> insert_or_overwrite -> trim_start_end -> ripple_remove_gaps -> review_story_question
timeline_pattern.source_rule: Use source In/Out points to bring only the useful portion into the timeline.
timeline_pattern.edit_button_rule: Choose insert, overwrite, replace, place-on-top, or append based on whether timeline timing should move.
timeline_pattern.gap_rule: Remove leading black and accidental gaps early so they do not become invisible problems.
timeline_pattern.question_rule: When a character looks, reacts, or moves toward something, insert the answer if it helps viewer orientation.

motion.rule: Do not add keyframed polish until the source selection and timeline order work.

sound.rule: Use waveforms to find speech starts and endings, but preserve meaningful pauses or breaths.

keyframe_values.dead_air_rule: For tight dialogue, remove accidental silence over 300 ms unless it has a story, joke, tension, or comprehension job.
keyframe_values.audio_edge_rule: Add short fades/crossfades when a tight trim clicks or exposes room-tone change.

captions.rule: Delay caption generation until the dialogue assembly is stable enough to avoid churn.

color.rule: Do not judge final color continuity from an unfinished story assembly.

implementation.ffmpeg: Store source in/out timecodes and edit operations in an EDL before trimming/concatenating.
implementation.remotion: Represent source ranges as clip objects with sourceStart, sourceEnd, timelineStart, and insertMode.
implementation.blender: Use VSE strip start/end trims and markers for story questions before adding animation.
implementation.capcut_equivalent: Preview source, trim to useful range, insert into timeline, then ripple remove gaps.
implementation.premiere_equivalent: Use Source Monitor I/O, Insert/Overwrite, Replace, Overwrite on top tracks, ripple trim, and gap deletion.

common_mistakes: Dragging whole clips to the timeline and trimming later only after the edit is crowded.
Leaving black frames at the beginning or between clips.
Using overwrite when insert should preserve later timing, or insert when overwrite should keep timing locked.
Cutting out every waveform gap without watching whether the pause carries meaning.
qc: Does every placed source range start and end on useful story material?
Are there no accidental gaps, black frames, or leading dead space?
Did insert/overwrite choices preserve the intended timeline timing?
Do reaction or look beats receive the needed answer shot?
Does the rough cut make sense before polish?
